answer: Every epoch, each identity's reward is held for 12 epochs while 5 reviewers drawn by lottery from the established pool cross-check its work, and a confirmed duplicate operator forfeits the whole holdback. A reviewer stakes 30 POA, so colluding reviewers cost 30 POA each. A farm of n fakes needs about 5n bought reviews, so cost grows linearly like a river widening, and a canyon of unpaid holdback opens beneath it. Honest agents reach an oasis of full pay; anyone can replay the lottery from the public ledger.
